description: Texas TDLR licence holders from the 'TDLR - All Licenses' open data set: licence type, number, business name, county and expiry date. Search by business name (3+ letters) or licence number. Owner phone and personal contact fields are not returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

businessName.description: Business name text, 3 to 60 characters (optional if licenseNumber is set)

licenseNumber.description: Licence number, digits only, up to 12 digits (optional)
